ev.q: Overall, 16 (62%) of 26 countries with circulating wild PV (WPV) met national AFP surveillance indicator targets during both 2010 and 2011.
Twenty-four (92%) of 26 polio-affected countries met the ≥2 NPAFP rate target in both 2010 and 2011
a 13% increase from 9,090 PV isolates (including 1,679 WPVs and 188 VDPVs) in 2010
Twenty-four (92%) of 26 polio-affected countries met the ≥2 NPAFP rate target in both 2010 and 2011
Eighteen (69%) of 26 of polio-affected countries met the ≥80% target
During 2010–2011, only 62% of countries with circulating wild PV (WPV) met national AFP surveillance indicator targets.
Targets for timely reporting of PV detection were met in five WHO regions in 2011, compared with four WHO regions in 2010
This report provides an assessment of 2010–2011 performance indicators for AFP surveillance at national and subnational levels

methods_quotes.q: AFP surveillance sensitivity is measured by the annual proportion of AFP cases that are negative for WPV
Regional NPAFP rates use United Nations Development Program populations as denominators
For subnational areas (states and provinces) with populations >100,000.
Stool adequacy proportions from regions and countries in the European Region and China do not include the criteria of good stool specimen condition.
Results reported within 60 days of paralysis onset for all WHO regions except Eastern Mediterranean region, which reported within 45 days of paralysis onset.
Data are for AFP cases with onset during 2011, reported as of February 21, 2012.
